description: Add an entry to an existing address.
embedding_description: Add an entry to an existing address with field_type, description, and value. Use to append host, port, url, token reference, or notes. Returns entry_id for the new entry. Entries can include vault:: references for secure values.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: New entry added to address with entry_id
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.
